quotes.text: Collect business tax IDs for invoices and VAT refunds.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: The Tax ID Element is an embeddable UI component that collects customer tax ID information.
The Tax ID Element adapts to the location of a customer by default, and it only shows if tax ID collection is common in their country.
To save and redisplay the tax ID, you must create a [CustomerSession](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customer_sessions.md).
